title: Final Answer for Doppler
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct final answer for the Doppler broadening width, Gamma_D.

title: Final Answer for Collision
description: Essential Criteria: Provide a reasonable estimate for the collision broadening width, Gamma_c, if calculated.

title: Doppler Effect Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Clearly explain the Doppler effect and its contribution to spectral line broadening.

title: Collision Broadening Discussion
description: Important Criteria: Discuss the role of collisions in broadening and how it differs from Doppler broadening.

title: Use of Uncertainty Principle
description: Important Criteria: Apply the uncertainty principle correctly to relate energy uncertainty to time.

title: Parameter Estimates
description: Optional Criteria: Provide reasonable order-of-magnitude estimates for parameters used in calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of formulas.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Check for any missing factors or constants in the calculations.
